about.what: One entry per file in 1-SOURCES/Text/: title, author, file_type, commentary_of, translation_of, the 0-INBOX folder the file sits in, duplicates in our corpus, the file's own source, the metadata of the OpenPecha record it matches, and the text check of that match.
about.built_by: 0-INBOX/temp/text-relations/build.py (re-run to rebuild; edits by hand are lost)
about.data: titles and panditas: 1-SOURCES/Text/text_catalog.json; relations: OpenPecha API dump (texts.json at 9de3d6d4^, instance incipit titles at ee311fd8^); metadata and texts: 1-SOURCES/openpecha-v2-catalog.json and the OpenPecha conversions removed in 124597e4 / 9de3d6d4

file_type_values.root-text: a root text (only from the context reading: the data never shows it)
file_type_values.commentary: comments on another text (commentary_of, when known)

sources.openpecha-data: an OpenPecha relation (type + target) on a text-checked match
sources.context: read from the text by an agent (title, opening, colophon, glossing, quoted root text); the decision and its evidence are in the entry's `context`, and kept in 0-INBOX/temp/text-relations/context.json. Data wins where both exist.

match_check_values.same-text: our text and the OpenPecha text share >= 80% of their 4-syllable sequences both ways
match_check_values.part: ours is >= 80% inside the OpenPecha text and covers >= 30% of it (one volume of it)
match_check_values.title-only: the OpenPecha text was never downloaded: only the title backs the match
match_check_values.fragment / contains / different: rejected — ours is a short excerpt of it / it is a short part of ours / the texts differ; no openpecha block, and its relations are not used

fields.author: the master whose collected works the file is in (text_catalog pandita) — the printed edition's grouping, not a verified authorship; OpenPecha's recorded author is in openpecha.author
fields.duplicate_of: our files with the same text (>= 80% shared both ways), among files that share a title or a matched OpenPecha record
fields.lang_tag / language / source / source_de: of our file (the Nalanda printed edition; source = its wb.pub link, which no longer resolves)
fields.openpecha: the matched OpenPecha record: text id, type, author(s) and translator(s) (each with its name in every language given, other names, BDRC person id), the conversion file it once had in 1-SOURCES/Text (former_file, removed_in), lang_tag, language, source, source_url, source_description, bdrc_work_id, license, category_id, category; null when no match survives
fields.match_check: the text check of that match (or of the closest rejected one)
fields.commentary_of / translation_of: {file: ours, if one has that title; title; the target record's OpenPecha metadata as above}
fields.inbox_folder: where the file is now (0-INBOX/root, commentary, translation) — the folders were sorted by hand (9d4bf89e), not from this data
